_comment: Pre-configured tools. Context7 and Notion work immediately via OAuth. Add tokens for GitHub and Beeper when you're ready.

context7._setup: Zero config — works immediately. Gives Claude live documentation for any library.

notion._setup: Approves via OAuth on first use — just click Approve in the browser. Lets Claude read and write your Notion workspace.

github._setup: Get a token at github.com/settings/tokens (classic, repo scope). Lets Claude create issues, read PRs, manage your repo.

beeper._setup: Account at beeper.com. Connect WhatsApp/LinkedIn/Instagram, then get your token from settings.

_surf_cli: Surf CLI generates images and browses the web from your terminal. Installed automatically by the setup script. Free, no account needed.
_optional_elevenlabs: Want voice too? ElevenLabs turns posts into audio messages. Add it: { "type": "stdio", "command": "uvx", "args": ["elevenlabs-mcp"], "env": { "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY": "your-key-here" } }. Free tier at elevenlabs.io.
